description: Admin-only Agent Command Center — canonical registry of every Astra AI agent (running on VPS, planned, archived). Query before scaffolding a new agent. Update status / current_job / responsibilities after non-trivial work. Every agent is owned by a MIND account (owner_username) and can be transferred or shared with other accounts as owner/viewer. Backed by /admin/agents on the MIND backend; admin API key required.

action.description: Action: list (filter+stats), get (detail+recent activities), create, update (partial), delete (soft archive; pass hard=true to remove), heartbeat (push from agent runtime), probe (HTTP/OpenClaw liveness probe), log_activity (manual note), list_activities, import_from_mind (enrich from agent-identity docs), seed_known (idempotent upsert of canonical seed), set_status (shortcut update), set_current_job (shortcut update), transfer_owner (move the agent to another account's board — needs owner_username), share (grant another account access — needs grantee_username + share_role), list_shares (who the agent is shared with), revoke_share (drop a share grant — needs share_id), list_invoices (invoices linked to an agent), link_invoice (attach an existing invoice id), unlink_invoice (detach an invoice id), create_invoice (create a new Invoice Agent draft + link it), list_workflows (workflows linked to an agent), link_workflow (attach an existing workflow slug — needs workflow_slug), unlink_workflow (detach a workflow — needs workflow_slug), used_by (inverse view: which agents call this workflow)

activity_type.description: Activity type for log_activity (e.g. job_done, job_start, error, note).

authority_can_autonomous.description: Things this agent can do without asking.

credentials_required.description: Named credentials this workflow touches (e.g. ['OpenAI API key', 'Resend API key', 'MIND tenant key']).

current_job.description: What the agent is doing right now (set on heartbeat or set_current_job).

expected_interval_seconds.description: Expected heartbeat cadence in seconds; live_status thresholds compute against 2× / 4× this value.

grantee_username.description: MIND account username to share the agent with (action=share). The account must already exist.

hard.description: If true with action=delete, permanently remove. Default soft-archives.

health_url.description: Optional HTTP health endpoint for the probe action.

host.description: Host: DO1 / DO2-LEO / local / render / vercel / atlas-droplet / other.

include_archived.description: Include archived records when listing (default false).

inputs_summary.description: One-line description of the data this workflow consumes.

invoice_id.description: Invoice id — required for link_invoice / unlink_invoice.

invoice_notes.description: Notes shown on the invoice for create_invoice.

kind.description: Registry kind. Pass on create to scaffold a Workflow card instead of an Agent. Pass on action=list (via list_kind) to filter the board.

limit.description: Max activities to return for list_activities (default 50).

list_kind.description: Filter the board by kind when listing — 'agent' or 'workflow'. Omit to return both.

list_query.description: Free-text search when listing — case-insensitive substring match across slug, name, description, and tags.

metrics.description: Arbitrary metrics blob attached to a heartbeat.

mind_identity_doc_id.description: MIND document id for the agent-identity record.

note.description: Free-form note attached to a heartbeat.

outputs_summary.description: One-line description of the artifacts this workflow produces.

overwrite.description: If true with action=seed_known, reset existing records to seed defaults.

owner_username.description: MIND account username to transfer the agent to (action=transfer_owner). The account must already exist.

responsibilities.description: Bullet list of what the agent does.

share_id.description: Share-grant id to revoke (action=revoke_share). Get it from list_shares.

share_role.description: Role for action=share: 'owner' (full control) or 'viewer' (read-only). Default: viewer.

source_path.description: Local path to the agent directory (e.g. /Users/anthonyjconti/Documents/Agents/Foo).

steps_json.description: JSON-encoded array of WorkflowStep dicts (kind='workflow' only). Each step: {order, name, description, kind, credentials[], inputs[], outputs[], notes}. Step kind ∈ {trigger, action, ai, branch, loop, wait, notify, output}.

trigger_summary.description: One-line description of what fires this workflow (kind='workflow' only).

triggers.description: Canonical phrases that should invoke this agent.

workflow_slug.description: Workflow slug — required for link_workflow / unlink_workflow.

name: mind_agents
